answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation, Form 8-K filed with SEC EDGAR on August 17, 2026; the report states the agreements were entered into on that date.
answer.note: NVIDIA reported entering residual value guaranties with SB Energy for leases covering approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site. Its cumulative payment obligation for the initial commitment is capped at $105 billion. The agreements generally become effective when the applicable leases commence, and payment depends on specified conditions, including ready-for-service conditions expected to begin in 2028, plus an OpenAI default following insolvency or failure to pay. NVIDIA would generally cover a shortfall against a guaranteed minimum value after replacement-lease or sale recoveries; OpenAI has agreed to reimburse and indemnify NVIDIA for amounts actually paid. NVIDIA may also, at its sole discretion, provide credit support for approximately 3.8 GW more, which is not part of the initial commitment. OpenAI is identified as tenant and is expected to use the site for NVIDIA’s DSX AI factory platform; NVIDIA says the partnership secures land, power, and shell capacity for its AI compute infrastructure. This supports a substantial prospective customer deployment and infrastructure-capacity signal, conditional on site readiness, lease commencement, and deployment. It does not establish NVIDIA product orders, revenue, actual guarantee payments, or an obligation for the optional additional 3.8 GW. The reported guarantee is also a potentially material contingent financial exposure, rather than evidence that NVIDIA has already paid the capped amount.
limitations: The report describes the agreements but says the full agreement forms will be filed with NVIDIA’s 10-Q; lease-specific allocation of the 4.25 GW, detailed valuation mechanics, and other terms are therefore not available in this report.

The report gives expected ready-for-service timing beginning in 2028, but does not establish when each lease will commence, whether all applicable conditions will be met, or whether any trigger event or payment has occurred.
The $105 billion figure is a cumulative cap, not an expected payment amount; the report does not quantify the probability or potential amount of a payment after recoveries or OpenAI reimbursement.
follow_up: Review the fiscal-quarter 10-Q and filed agreement forms for lease-level capacity, guarantee calculations, conditions, remedies, and termination terms.
Check subsequent NVIDIA filings for lease commencements, ready-for-service status, guarantee-trigger events, amounts paid or accrued, and any reimbursement from OpenAI.
Check subsequent company disclosures for whether OpenAI deploys the stated platform at the site and whether the optional additional 3.8 GW receives credit support.

proposal.question: Will NVIDIA report a material liability or payment exposure under its Portsmouth residual-value guaranties?
proposal.settled_by: Review NVIDIA’s next annual filing for disclosure of recognized liabilities, payments, or other material exposure under the Portsmouth guaranties.
proposal.lost_if_folded: Folding this into the site-deployment or demand question would lose separate tracking of NVIDIA’s potentially large, conditional guarantee exposure, which is distinct from whether the facility is delivered or used.
